title: PdfCraft nightly deep-background icons
author: @skylartaylor

inputs.purpose: native padded Mac 1024 master; not upscaled from 256

method.kind: original code-generated derivative of the project-owned icon
method.transform: Solve each pixel's background contribution from its red excess over its green/blue maximum and change only that contribution. Preserve alpha/padding and neutral foreground/detail RGBA byte for byte. Derive native-size frames separately from their corresponding unchanged-resolution masters and pack them into ICO/ICNS here. No crescent, letter or badge.
method.generator: work/nightlies-lead/fixes/pdfcraft-nightly-icons.py (outside the repository; the recipe is above)

validation: Source/input/output hashes, PNG dimensions, ICO/ICNS member sizes and the pixel proof checked: every pixel with no background contribution is byte-identical, and the field moved from #b70228 to #8a011e exactly. Visual comparison reviewed at 256 and 1024. Native Explorer/Finder/iconutil qualification remains unrun.
